diagram_math_checks.objects: All nonzero terms are kappa-vector spaces: m/m^2, Omega_{R/k} tensor_R kappa, Omega_{kappa/k}, with kappa=R/m. No dimensions or ranks are asserted.
diagram_math_checks.maps: i: m/m^2 -> Omega_{R/k} tensor_R kappa sends [x] to dx tensor 1; step 1.1 checks well-definedness modulo m^2 using the Leibniz relation. q sends dr tensor lambda to lambda d(r mod m); tensor balancing follows from the residue action on Omega_{kappa/k} and the universal differential relations in def-ag-universal-algebraic-differentials.
diagram_math_checks.relations: q i=0 because x in m has zero residue; ker(q)=im(i) and q is onto by steps 1.1 and 2.1. Step 4.1 proves injectivity, so the displayed top row is short exact under the statement hypotheses.

diagram_math_checks.maps: theta: Omega_{R/k} tensor_R kappa -> m/m^2 is the kappa-linear map of step 4.1 attached by lem-ag-differentials-universal-property to the derivation id-s pi of step 3.1. The backward curved arrow has this direction, not the direction of i.
diagram_math_checks.relations: theta i([x])=[x] for every x in m, exactly as step 4.1. The figure asserts theta i=id and does not assert i theta=id in the general case. The explanatory prose notes its dependence on the chosen section s.
diagram_math_checks.hypotheses: The section is constructed in steps 1.2 and 2.2 from a separating transcendence basis and a finite separable residual extension, using F2-F6. No injectivity without the stated separably generated finitely generated residue hypothesis is depicted.

diagram_math_checks.specialization: Only the additional finite separable residue case is used to set Omega_{kappa/k}=0, by step 1.3; then step 5.1 makes i an isomorphism and theta its inverse. The general diagram retains Omega_{kappa/k}. The existing rigorous proof is byte-for-byte preserved and independent of the illustration.
